description: A silver-haired woman in a white and black futuristic outfit sits on a stone throne holding a massive crystalline spear that glows with blue energy. She wears an enormous, intricate glowing blue headdress while surrounded by flying futuristic aircraft, floating crystalline structures, and a dramatic sunset sky over a ruined landscape.
title: Celestial Spear Sorceress
prompt: A beautiful silver-haired woman with pale skin sits centered on a dark stone throne, wearing a sleek white and black futuristic bodysuit with high slits. She holds a very long ornate spear made of glowing blue crystal and gold metal across her lap. She wears a massive, elaborate glowing blue crystalline headdress that floats above her head with light particles. Multiple angular dark futuristic fighter jets fly in formation around her in a cloudy sunset sky. Floating blue glowing crystalline shards hover nearby. Ruined stone pillars in the background, dramatic golden sunset lighting, cinematic composition, ethereal ribbons and sparkles, detailed fantasy digital art style
